note_en: 了 and 着 mark different aspects. 了 after a verb shows completion or a change: 车间里多了二十台橙色的机械臂 "there were now twenty orange robotic arms in the workshop." 着 shows an ongoing action or state: 它们一刻不停地转着 "they kept turning without a pause"; 年轻的技术员盯着电脑屏幕 "the young technicians stared at the computer screen." Roughly, 了 is "it happened," 着 is "it's going on."
